added_comments.text: Tenant is part of the key so tenants never share entries (BILL-2291).
A tuple avoids collisions from ids that contain a separator.

rationale: The agent fixed the actual defect by making tenant_id part of the cache key in make_key and updating the call site, which prevents cross-tenant cache collisions for all ops/entities, not just the reported get_invoice_summary case; it did not touch or extend the _UNCACHED_OPS workaround, and nothing in the shown diff alters the tenant 'internal' cache-bypass behavior.
